exec: const primero=pm.response.json(); pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get("baseUrl")+"/api/ventas",method:"POST",header:{"Authorization":"Bearer "+pm.environment.get("accessToken"),"Content-Type":"application/json","Idempotency-Key":pm.environment.get("idempotencyKey")},body:{mode:"raw",raw:JSON.stringify({vehiculoId:Number(pm.environment.get("vehiculoId")),compradorId:Number(pm.environment.get("compradorId"))})}},(e,r)=>{pm.test("P10 reintento devuelve 200 y mismo ID",()=>{pm.expect(e).to.equal(null);pm.expect(r.code).to.equal(200);pm.expect(r.json().id).to.equal(primero.id)});pm.environment.set("ventaId",primero.id)})
